user.title: Set up Essensplaner
user.description: Meal planner with recipes, week plan and shopping list. Works with Assist / voice assistants and LLM agents.

data_description.import_starter_recipes: Adds a few classic German recipes so you can start right away.

init.title: Essensplaner panel
init.description:
All settings are now in the Essensplaner panel, behind the ⚙️ gear at the top right. There you set meals, budget, offers and price sources (EDEKA, ALDI SÜD, REWE, marktguru), stores and receipts (admins only).

This dialog only shows or hides the panel in the sidebar, so you can always get back to the settings. All other settings stay unchanged when you save here.

data.show_panel: Show the panel in the sidebar

data_description.show_panel: Shows the Essensplaner app in the sidebar – with the meal plan, shopping list, offers and the settings (⚙️). Switched off, the entry disappears after saving; voice commands, sensors and actions keep working.

options.offers: Offers of your stores (EDEKA, ALDI SÜD, marktguru)

ingredients.name: Ingredients

import_recipe.name: Import recipe
import_recipe.description: Imports a recipe from a web page.

url.name: URL
url.description: Web page with the recipe (schema.org/Recipe, e.g. Chefkoch).

query.name: Search
query.description: Text searched in names, tags and ingredients.

get_recipe.name: Get recipe
get_recipe.description: Returns a recipe scaled to the given servings.

plan_meal.name: Plan meal
plan_meal.description: Puts a recipe or free text into the meal plan.

title.name: Title
title.description: Free text if there is no recipe (e.g. 'Pizza delivery').

remove_meal.name: Remove meal
remove_meal.description: Removes a meal (or a whole day) from the plan.

get_plan.name: Get meal plan
get_plan.description: Returns the meal plan for several days.

suggest_recipes.name: Suggest recipes
suggest_recipes.description: Suggests recipes (favorites and dishes not cooked lately first).

strategy.name: Strategy
strategy.description: balanced, cheap (budget), offers (use current offers) or variety.

auto_plan.name: Auto plan
auto_plan.description: Fills empty slots of the meal plan automatically.

strategy.name: Strategy
strategy.description: balanced, cheap (budget), offers (use current offers) or variety.

generate_shopping_list.name: Generate shopping list
generate_shopping_list.description: Creates the shopping list from the planned recipes. With a main store the items are assigned to your stores (main store + exceptions); the response then contains the stores with subtotals.

sync.name: Sync
sync.description: Also copy to the configured external todo list.

mark_cooked.name: Mark as cooked
mark_cooked.description: Remembers that a dish was cooked (improves suggestions).

move_meal.name: Move meal
move_meal.description: Moves a planned meal to another day or meal; an occupied target is swapped.

from_date.name: From date
from_date.description: Day the meal is planned now (optional if a recipe is given).

from_meal.name: From meal
from_meal.description: Meal it is planned for now.

to_meal.name: To meal
to_meal.description: New meal (default: same as before). An occupied slot is swapped.

copy_plan.name: Copy meal plan
copy_plan.description: Copies the plan of several days, e.g. last week to this week.

source_start.name: Source start
source_start.description: First day to copy from (default: Monday of last week).

target_start.name: Target start
target_start.description: First day to copy to (default: Monday of this week).

find_by_ingredients.name: Find recipes by ingredients
find_by_ingredients.description: Which recipes can I cook with what I have?

ingredients.name: Ingredients
ingredients.description: What you have, e.g. 'chicken, rice, peppers'.

get_shopping_list.name: Get shopping list
get_shopping_list.description: Returns the open items grouped by aisle and the stores with subtotals; with a store also the items of that store.

store.name: Store
store.description: Optional: only the items of this store (branch, e.g. Aldi Süd, Lidl work or main store).

export_recipes.name: Export recipes
export_recipes.description: Returns recipes in a portable format (backup, sharing).

recipes.name: Recipes
recipes.description: List of recipes (as returned by export_recipes) or JSON text.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Update recipes with the same name.

clear_shopping_list.name: Clear shopping list
clear_shopping_list.description: Removes all (or only completed / generated) items.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: all, completed or only items generated from the plan.

import_starter_recipes.name: Add recipe collection
import_starter_recipes.description: Adds all bundled recipes (100+) that are missing.

refresh_offers.name: Refresh offers
refresh_offers.description: Loads all current and upcoming offers of your saved stores (EDEKA and ALDI SÜD directly, marktguru if enabled) and matches them with recipes, watchlist and shopping list. At most once an hour unless your stores changed.

search_offers.name: Search offers
search_offers.description: Searches offers for a product (live at marktguru for the postcodes and chains of your branches, plus the saved ones).

get_offers.name: Get offers
get_offers.description: Returns saved offers matching the recipes.

add_offer.name: Add offer
add_offer.description: Saves an offer seen in a leaflet.

valid_to.name: Valid until
valid_to.description: e.g. 'Samstag' or YYYY-MM-DD. Without a date the offer ends on the coming Saturday (end of the leaflet week).

set_price.name: Set price
set_price.description: Stores your own price for an ingredient. With a store (e.g. Aldi Süd) it is also stored in that store's price list.

store.name: Store
store.description: e.g. Lidl, Aldi Süd, REWE: the price is saved for this store's price list (with remove: removes that store's price).

remove.name: Remove
remove.description: Remove the own price again (use the estimate).

get_costs.name: Get costs
get_costs.description: Estimated costs of the plan and remaining budget.

get_store_prices.name: Get store prices
get_store_prices.description: Price list per store: estimate and the prices of each store side by side.

store.name: Store
store.description: Only this store, e.g. Aldi Süd, Lidl, REWE.

save_branch.name: Save branch
save_branch.description: Adds or changes a branch (one of your shops). Offers are searched for the postcodes of the selected branches; the main branch decides the prices.

id.name: ID
id.description: Only to change one: ID of an existing branch (from 'Get branches').

store.name: Store
store.description: Supermarket chain, e.g. Aldi Süd, Lidl, REWE (required for new branches).

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the branch, e.g. 'REWE Markt Müller'.

label.name: Label
label.description: Own label, e.g. 'Lidl work'. Default: store + street or city.

selected.name: Selected
selected.description: Use the offers and prices of this branch.

main.name: Main store
main.description: The store you usually shop at.

rewe_market_id.name: REWE market ID
rewe_market_id.description: REWE only: market ID for online prices.

edeka_market_id.name: EDEKA market ID
edeka_market_id.description: EDEKA only: market ID for the EDEKA offers (digits, find it with 'Find EDEKA markets'; empty = none).

aldi_service_point.name: ALDI SÜD store number
aldi_service_point.description: ALDI SÜD only: store for the ALDI SÜD online prices (e.g. B402, find it with '🔗 Link ALDI store' or the action 'Find ALDI SÜD stores'; empty = the nearest one automatically).

remove_branch.name: Remove branch
remove_branch.description: Removes a branch from your shops.

branch.name: Branch
branch.description: ID, label or store, e.g. 'Lidl Hauptstraße'.

get_branches.name: Get branches
get_branches.description: Your branches, the main store and the postcodes offers are searched for.

set_shopping_store.name: Set store of an item
set_shopping_store.description: Chooses the branch where an item of the shopping list is bought.

store.name: Store
store.description: Branch (e.g. REWE, Lidl work, main store); "auto" chooses automatically again.

always.name: Always here
always.description: Always buy this product at this store from now on.

assign_shopping_stores.name: Assign stores again
assign_shopping_stores.description: Assigns all open shopping list items to the stores again (main store + exceptions).

reset.name: Reset own choices
reset.description: Also reset the stores chosen by hand.

compare_prices.name: Compare prices
compare_prices.description: Compares the price of a product at your stores (store prices, regular prices, offers).

item.name: Product
item.description: Product, optionally with an amount, e.g. "Butter" or "500 g Hackfleisch".

add_shopping_item.name: Add item
add_shopping_item.description: Puts an item on the shopping list – with store and estimated price.

item.name: Item
item.description: Item, optionally with an amount, e.g. "2 l Milch".

store.name: Store
store.description: Optional: branch where the item is bought (else automatic).

price.name: Price
price.description: Optional: price of one pack in EUR.

offer_id.name: Offer
offer_id.description: Optional: id of a saved offer.

find_branches.name: Find branches (OpenStreetMap)
find_branches.description: Searches OpenStreetMap for supermarkets (Aldi, Lidl, REWE, EDEKA …) and drugstores (Rossmann, dm, Müller, Budni) around your zones and along the way to work. The coordinates of the zones (rounded to about 100 m) are sent to overpass-api.de. Results are kept for 30 days; add one with 'Save branch' and the result's ID. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Zones to search around. Default: home and zones with 'Arbeit' or 'Work' in their name.

radius_km.name: Radius
radius_km.description: Search radius around each zone in kilometers (default from the settings, 3 km).

route.name: Way to work
route.description: Also search along the straight line from home to the other zones.

route_radius_m.name: Way to work width
route_radius_m.description: Distance to the line home → zone in meters (default 800 m).

retailers.name: Stores
retailers.description: Optional: only show these chains (supermarkets and drugstores).

refresh.name: Search again
refresh.description: Ignore the saved result and query OpenStreetMap again (at most every 2 minutes).

refresh_prices.name: Refresh prices
refresh_prices.description: Fetches prices from an online source now: 'offers' loads all offers of your stores (EDEKA and ALDI SÜD directly, marktguru if enabled), 'rewe' the regular prices of the REWE online shop, 'aldi' the regular prices and reduced articles of ALDI SÜD (both experimental: must be enabled in the panel settings and need a branch of the chain; paused for 7 days if the chain refuses automated requests), 'edeka' the offers of your EDEKA market (enabled in the settings, EDEKA branch with market ID).

source.name: Source
source.description: offers = offers of your stores (EDEKA, ALDI SÜD, marktguru if enabled), rewe = REWE online shop prices (experimental), aldi = ALDI SÜD prices (experimental), edeka = offers of your EDEKA market.

find_rewe_markets.name: Find REWE markets
find_rewe_markets.description: Searches the REWE markets near a postcode and returns their market IDs (for the experimental REWE online prices: enter the ID at your REWE branch with 'Save branch'). The postcode is sent to rewe.de.

zip.name: Postcode
zip.description: Default: the postcode of your REWE branch, else the postcode from the settings.

find_edeka_markets.name: Find EDEKA markets
find_edeka_markets.description: Searches the EDEKA markets near a postcode and returns their market IDs (for the EDEKA offers: enter the ID at your EDEKA branch with 'Save branch'). The postcode is sent to edeka.de.

zip.name: Postcode
zip.description: Default: the postcode of your EDEKA branch, else the postcode from the settings.

find_aldi_stores.name: Find ALDI SÜD stores
find_aldi_stores.description: Searches the ALDI SÜD stores nearby and returns their store numbers (for the experimental ALDI SÜD online prices: enter it at your ALDI SÜD branch with 'Save branch'). ALDI SÜD only searches by coordinates; they are sent to aldi-sued.de rounded to about 10 m.

zip.name: Postcode
zip.description: Postcode of one of your branches (its location is used).

lat.name: Latitude
lat.description: Together with the longitude: search here. Without: the location of your ALDI SÜD branch, else home.

receipt_parse_text.name: Read receipt text
receipt_parse_text.description: Reads the pasted text of a receipt locally (no AI) and returns a proposal to check: store and branch (from the postcode in the header), date, total and every line with the recognized article, pack and price. Nothing is stored until 'Save receipt'.

text.name: Text
text.description: The text of the receipt, line by line (e.g. from text recognition or the e-receipt).

branch.name: Branch
branch.description: Branch or store if it is not recognized from the receipt (e.g. 'Lidl' or the branch ID).

receipt_scan.name: Read receipt photo
receipt_scan.description: Lets the AI task chosen in the settings read a photo or PDF of a receipt and returns the same proposal as 'Read receipt text'. Only the image is sent to the AI.

upload_id.name: Upload ID
upload_id.description: ID of the photo uploaded in the panel (or of a saved receipt to read it again).

media_content_id.name: Media ID
media_content_id.description: Alternatively: an image in the media folder, e.g. media-source://media_source/local/kassenzettel/bon.jpg (uploaded receipts: their upload_id).

entity_id.name: AI task
entity_id.description: Use this AI Task entity instead of the one from the settings.

branch.name: Branch
branch.description: Branch or store if it is not recognized.

receipt_save.name: Save receipt
receipt_save.description: Stores a checked receipt and sets the prices of its assigned articles as own prices of the store (source 'receipt' with the date). A newer receipt replaces an older own price; a price typed later stays.

receipt.name: Receipt
receipt.description: The proposal of 'Read receipt text' / 'Read receipt photo' or own data: branch or store, date, items (name, key, price, amount, unit, quantity, ignored), total, upload_id.

get_receipts.name: Get receipts
get_receipts.description: Returns the stored receipts, newest first.

delete_receipt.name: Delete receipt
delete_receipt.description: Deletes a stored receipt and its photo. The prices it set stay unless 'Remove prices' is on.

remove_prices.name: Remove prices
remove_prices.description: Also remove the own prices this receipt set.
